items.description: Ashentia Hauntings 2 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Noah, who decided to investigate the various haunted locations of Ashentia, a place that is surrounded by hills and forests.In the 1950s, the house was built on the land surrounded by trees, located almost an hour away from the Ashentia shopping district. In the beginning, a family used to live there for a few decades. During the 1990s, 2 members of the family died in a brutal car accident while returning home, which happened in Ashentia Highway Block E, where a truck driver was at fault. A few days following the incident, the owner sold the house to a popular businessman of the city. The house was then rented out to a family who are said to have been complaining about weird paranormal activities happening inside the house for the past few months. The family living there has experienced a lot of paranormal activities, which included unexplained noises coming from the basement, a woman's disembodied laughing sounds, and stick-thumping noises heard during the nighttime. Also, there are car horn sounds coming from the garage area of the house out of nowhere almost at 3 AM every night. There was no explanation of how that happened. So, the paranormal enthusiast, Noah, got a call from the current owner of the house to check it out to provide them with answers.You play as Noah, the paranormal enthusiast, and your mission is to investigate the haunted house for proof of the paranormal. Will you be able to assist your client?Key Features:Explore the entire haunted house!The various kinds of evil spirits lurking in the shadows!Avoid dangerous traps like spikes, fire, etc.Collect various items like keys, Brown box etc.Explore spirit world carefully.Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation.Warning:This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. items.description: Mei Paranormies is a 2D top-down survival horror game where you play as Mei, the paranormal investigator, who got a call from the owner of a haunted restaurant to check it out for proof of the paranormal.Nokiloc restaurant was built during the 1980s in San Francisco by Rob, the former owner of the restaurant. The business was booming during the late 1980s. But in the year 1990, there was a devastating fire incident that killed a restaurant waiter and a few customers. While most of the people, which included customers and restaurant staff, were evacuated safely by the firefighters. A few of them who were stuck in the restaurant during the evacuation process died either due to suffocation or burns. In 1992, the Nokiloc restaurant was sold to Chris, the current owner, who reopened the restaurant later that year after renovation, and customers started to come in again. But there were reports of paranormal activities in the restaurant. During the night hours, the spirits are often seen sitting on empty chairs, in the kitchen areas, etc. The dark apparitions are also often observed by the restaurant staff in the basement and in the storage rooms. It is said that a spirit with a badly burned face is often seen roaming in the hallways near the staff's bedrooms. Disembodied crying and screaming noises are often heard during the midnight hours. Because of the rise in paranormal activities, the restaurant business got affected. This had compelled the owner, Chris, to contact Mei, the paranormal investigator, to check it out and provide him with some answers.You play as Mei, a paranormal investigator, and will you be able to help out your client?Key Features:Explore the haunted restaurant for the proof of the paranormal.Collect items like keys, haunted objects like ladies bag, engagement ring etc.Come face to face with the spirits!Use scientific equipment like EVP recorder, emf meter!Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation!Warning:This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. items.description: Zereoton Hauntings 3 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Mateo who loves to investigate the various haunted locations in the US.Mateo, the paranormal enthusiast, got a call from a family living in Kentucky who have been experiencing paranormal activity for the past few months and were concerned about the safety of their kids. The house was built during the early 2000s, and there have been no reports of deaths on that property to date. As a result, the family was confused and couldn't understand why the paranormal activities started occurring in their home. The owner shared his experience with Mateo before the beginning of the investigation. He said that his son was so scared that he refused to sleep alone in his room because he saw a tall, black shadow man calling out his name every night. Initially, he didn't believe him until he too saw a tall, dark creature in the basement area of the home. The family completely stopped entering the basement area ever since that day. One day, his wife was sleeping in her bed and she felt her bed being shaken violently by an unseen force which woke her up from sleep. She got so scared that she had to immediately leave the house without a second thought and had to spend the rest of the night in her car. After the incident, she refused to stay in the house alone. The owner also reported hearing disembodied laughs and footsteps in the hallway area, and witnessing multiple floating orbs and shadow figures. Finally, the owner decided to get in touch with Mateo so that he could provide him with some answers. You play as Mateo, the paranormal enthusiast, and will you be able to escape the haunted house safely?Key Features:Explore the entire family house in Kentucky!Come face-to-face with the unrest spirits!Collect items like keys, golden ring, flower vase etc.Avoid traps like fire, rotating blades, spikes etc.Explore unknown spirit dimension!Nearly half-an hour of paranormal investigation.Warning:This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions.
